description: A library that starts disposable Docker containers, such as a real database, from inside a test.
A Docker-API compatible engine that must be available on every machine and CI agent that runs Testcontainers tests.
A field annotation that tells the Testcontainers JUnit extension to start the container, where a static field is shared by the whole test class.
A Spring Boot annotation that configures the application's connection from a container bean, with no URL properties.
Naming an exact image version such as postgres:17-alpine so that a new image cannot change test results.
An experimental opt-in that keeps a container running between local runs and is not suited for CI.
The Maven plugin that runs classes named IT in the integration-test phase and fails the build in verify.
